description_en: Edits a task in the industry edition
name: EditTask

parameters.help_en: The task ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务id
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Modifies the task status. Valid values:
2: started.
4: stopped.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态 修改任务状态，2：开启；4：停止；
注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The task name. Modifies the task name. The name cannot exceed 100 characters.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称 修改任务名称，不能超过100个字符；
注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The script templatetype. Valid values:
1: single-mode template.
2: intelligent script Policy Template.

Note: If you do not pass parameter, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
话术模板类型 1：单模 版；2：智能话术策略模板；
注：不传参视为不修改
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The script template ID.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh: 话术模板ID 注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The concurrency. Modifies the concurrency. Default value: 1. The value cannot exceed the maximum concurrency configured for the enterprise.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
并发数 修改并发数。默认为1，不可超过企业设置最高并发数；
注：不传参视为不修改
parameters.name: max_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The recall configuration. Valid values: 1, 2, and 3. Default value: 1.
1: no recall.
2: interval-based recall.
3: scheduled recall.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
重呼配置 可选值：1，2，3，默认为1； 1：不重呼；2：间隔重呼；3：定时重呼；
注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: recall_type

parameters.help_en:
The call time. Format example: "8:30-12:00 13:30-19:00" is passed as [[8.5,12][13.5,19]].

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.name: call_time_list

parameters.help_en:
The recall interval. Required when the recall option is 2. Unit: minutes. Supports positive integers ≥ 1.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
重呼间隔 当重呼选项为2时，必填；单位为分钟，支持≥1的正整数
注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: repeat_interval

parameters.help_en:
The recall count. Required when the recall option is 2. Supports positive integers ≥ 1.

Note: If this parameter is not passed, the value is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
重呼次数 当重呼选项为2时，必填；支持≥1正整数
注：不传参视为不修改；
parameters.name: repeat_count

parameters.help_en: The recall time
parameters.help_zh: 重呼时间
parameters.name: repeat_times

parameters.help_en: The recording URL
parameters.help_zh: 录音地址
parameters.name: record_path

parameters.help_en: The playback interval duration
parameters.help_zh: 播放间隔时长
parameters.name: play_sleep_val

parameters.help_en: The recording playback count
parameters.help_zh: 录音播放次数
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The SMS sending rule. Specifies the sending rule for hang-up SMS messages. If empty, no SMS is sent
parameters.help_zh: 短信发送规则 设定挂机短信的发送规则，若为空，则视为不发送
parameters.name: send_sms_plan

parameters.help_en: The recall condition
parameters.help_zh: 重呼条件
parameters.name: repeat_reason

parameters.help_en: The callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The flash SMS configuration. Default value: 0. Valid values:
0: do not send flash SMS.
1: send flash SMS
parameters.help_zh: 发送闪信配置,默认为0,0不发送闪信.1发送闪信
parameters.name: flash_sms_type

parameters.help_en: The flash SMS template ID. Required when the flash SMS configuration is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 当发送闪信配置为1时，闪信模板ID必填
parameters.name: flash_sms_template_id

fields.help_zh: 第一个调用时间字符串
fields.name: call_time

parameters.help_en: The call time accurate to minutes. If both fields have values, this field takes precedence. Use this field for minute-level precision. Example: 08:31-12:05 13:33-19:00 is passed as [["08:31","12:05"]["13:33","19:00"]]. Default value: [["08:00","20:00"]]
parameters.name: call_time_str_list

parameters.help_en: The days of the week for outbound calls. Example: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7] indicates calls are made from Monday to Sunday
parameters.help_zh: 外呼时间需要的按星期几进行外呼，例：[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]，代表周一到周日都外呼
parameters.name: week_tag
